lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Tracing shadows on the garden wall
Waiting for the morning light to fall
Every seed is dreaming deep below
Waiting for the secret strength to grow
[Chorus]
The mountains rise to meet the sky
Where the river flows and spirits fly
A symphony of color, wild and deep
In the garden where the memories sleep
[Verse]
Walking through the whispers of the pine
Finding where the earth and heaven line
Every breath is heavy with the dew
Every path is leading something new
[Chorus]
The mountains rise to meet the sky
Where the river flows and spirits fly
A symphony of color, wild and deep
In the garden where the memories sleep
[Bridge]
The winter's chill begins to fade
Into the warmth the golden sun has made
[Chorus]
The mountains rise to meet the sky
Where the river flows and spirits fly
A symphony of color, wild and deep
In the garden where the memories sleep
[Outro]
